component.name: fillmate
component.summary: Fill recurring paperwork from reusable form packs

description.p: fillmate turns the forms you fill in again and again into a small form: type what changes, check the preview, and email the filled PDF and Word documents.

ul.li: Fills flat and fillable PDFs and Word documents from reusable form packs
Remembers your details, so you only type what is new each time
Shows a preview before anything is saved or sent
Sends the result through Gmail or SMTP, or opens a draft in your mail app
